notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (no business-type funds; School Nutrition is a special revenue fund in the governmental statement, so governmental). Beginning/ending cash = fund balance beginning/end of year (p6), which equals cash 4,232,959 + county treasurer 607,048 + investments 125,596 (p4); the investments of 125,596 are printed separately (pp1, 4) but are inside ending_cash, so ending_investments is left null to avoid counting them twice. Statement p5-6 total column used. Re-check 2026-10-28: the printed statement Taxes line 4,977,195 is split into the user's own categories using the budget schedules (General Fund p7 lines 1100-1140 and 3130-3180 = 4,771,780, plus Special Building p14 = 205,415): property tax 2,965,358, penalties and interest on taxes 9,966, motor vehicle tax 195,559, carline 2,956, public power district sales tax 35,466, homestead exemption 57,053, property tax credit 1,701,375, pro-rate motor vehicle 9,462; state receipts on the statement (1,132,455 = General 1,131,451 + Nutrition 1,004) exclude those credits. County receipts 17,016 split per p7: 2110 county fines and license fees 15,083 (Fines and Licenses) and 2210 ESU receipts 1,933 (ESU Receipts). Local receipts 534,935 split using the fund budget schedules (pp7-14) for each p6 fund column: interest 95,221 (Interest Income), activities/extracurricular receipts 208,410 (Extracurricular Receipts), other charges 162,926, license fees 2,548, plus the Foundation column 65,830, split from the Statement of Activities (p2): interest 19,553 (Interest Income; 114,774 total interest less 95,221 of other funds) and scholarship receipts 46,277 (donations/contributions, review). Function codes: 2510 business services -> Business, 2650 vehicle acquisition and maintenance -> Building and Grounds. Balance sheet (re-check 2026-10-28): governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances, Governmental Funds total column (p4), with fund balance by classification, because its total 4,965,603 equals the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1); committed is blank and omitted; no liabilities printed, so total_liabilities is null. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (pp7-8) is used for the General Fund; Depreciation and Employee Benefit fund schedules (pp9-10) are separate budget schedules, and the p16 combining schedule (by function only, same amounts) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Transfer cross-check: General Fund budget schedule total disbursements 6,033,998 include line 8000 Transfers 90,055 (to Activities 60,055 and Nutrition 30,000) and a further 75,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund hidden inside 27RG regular pupil transportation (printed 342,616 vs 267,616 in the p16 General column; total transfers out of General 165,055 on p16). Both recorded as other financing (signed negative) and the expenditure total is marked as including other financing. On the p5-6 governmental statement the 75,000 is eliminated within the combined General Fund, so net transfers are 90,055 in/out. Receiving funds match: Depreciation 75,000, Activities 60,055, Nutrition 30,000. Zero-amount lines (5300 Sale of property) omitted. Statement of Activities p2 not used for receipts.
